summary: Frontend E2E testing of Iter 282 Dealer Parts changes (Stock Movement merged tab + sub-tabs, unsaved-work confirm() guard on Allocation Wizard, invoice-number field, duplicate invoice HARD-BLOCK, dealer invoice log). All 6 acceptance criteria PASS end-to-end against the preview URL. Tested via owner@isodemo.com against Fitline Deutschland dealer.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option text in a <span>. Non-blocking (dealer select still works and value posts correctly). Consider suppressing the x-source-* wrapper for children of <option>.

acceptance_results.1_tabs_merged: PASS — dp-tab-stock-movement present (count=1); dp-tab-ledger / dp-tab-replenishment / dp-tab-rma no longer exist as top-level tabs (count=0 each).
acceptance_results.2_sub_tabs: PASS — clicking Stock Movement renders dp-stock-sub-ledger / dp-stock-sub-replenishment / dp-stock-sub-rma; switching between them renders each child tab without errors.
acceptance_results.3_unsaved_guard: PASS — with empty wizard, switching top tab does NOT prompt. After typing order value, switching top tab shows window.confirm 'You have unsaved work in this section...'. Dismissing keeps user on dp-wiz-step0; accepting navigates away (dealers tab visible).
acceptance_results.4_invoice_field: PASS — dp-wiz-invoice-ref input exists in step 0 with helper text 'logged against the dealer; each invoice can only be allocated once'.
acceptance_results.5_duplicate_hard_block: PASS — Created 1st allocation with UITEST-282147 -> succeeded (step2 visible). Retrying same invoice -> approve returned 409, red banner dp-wiz-duplicate-warning shown after Back, dp-wiz-generate becomes disabled with label 'Invoice already used'. Toast 'already been allocated' also observed.
acceptance_results.6_dealer_invoice_log: PASS — Opening Fitline Deutschland dealer profile shows dp-dealer-invoices section with row dp-invoice-row-UITEST-282147 containing invoice ref, date 2026-07-16, parts count 12, Draft status badge and value £572.

action_items: Optional: suppress the visual-editor <span> wrapping inside <option> to silence the hydration warning in the dealer select.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate warning banner dp-wiz-duplicate-warning is only rendered in step 0; when a 409 comes back at approve-time (step 1), the user must click Back to see the banner. UX-wise consider surfacing the banner on step 1 too, or auto-returning to step 0 on 409 approve.
Reset button (`Start over`) is not gated by the unsaved-work confirm — clicking it silently wipes state; consider gating.
beforeunload guard is correctly armed via dirtyRef; cleanup in useEffect return handler present.
seed_data_creation: Created one draft allocation UITEST-282147 against Fitline Deutschland (per user note, cleanup not required).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav path: /service-desk -> Stores sidebar -> Dealer Parts sub-tab. Dealer select uses <select value=dealer_id>; use value= (not label regex) in Playwright. Dealer picker BOM search 'a' returns 8 machines (works). window.confirm dialogs fired synchronously from onClick — Playwright must set page.on('dialog', ...) BEFORE the click.
